chapter_summary: Shen Feizhi recovers in a pocket dimension managed by A11 and C2 after his shuttle self-destructed. He learns he is the rightful 'Child of Destiny' whose identity was usurped. After his physical recovery, he accesses his memories, revealing his tragic past: he was a neglected child saved by Gu Suizhou's parents (Lin Zizhuo and Gu Lang). He made a death-vow to protect Gu Suizhou, leading to his long-term, patient care for the boy, which explains his past behavior toward Gu Suizhou.

new_characters.name: A11
new_characters.description: A high-dimensional being and manager on the Main Star. Cold, mechanical, and socially inept.

new_characters.name: C2
new_characters.description: An Alpha with an androgynous, youthful appearance and snaggleteeth. He specializes in medicine and clerical records.

new_characters.name: Lin Zizhuo
new_characters.description: Deceased. A gentle man who, along with his wife, saved Shen Feizhi from a basement and entrusted him with Gu Suizhou's safety.

new_characters.name: Gu Lang
new_characters.description: Deceased. A gentle woman who entrusted Shen Feizhi with a secret injection and the task of protecting her son.

new_characters.name: Shen Wei
new_characters.description: A member of the Shen family who abused and starved Shen Feizhi in his childhood.

new_locations.name: Main Star
new_locations.description: The high-dimensional hub where managers and special professionals reside.

new_locations.name: Energy Vortex
new_locations.description: A dangerous space where Shen Feizhi entered after his shuttle crash.

new_locations.name: Pocket Dimension
new_locations.description: A sterile, customizable space created by A11 for Shen Feizhi's recovery.

ambiguous.question: A11 and C2 are high-dimensional beings. Should they be referred to with neutral pronouns or masculine ones given their roles?
